title: Oracle WebLogic error page disclosed in a response
description: The response is the WebLogic Server error page: it names the application server and reports Error 500 with the servlet context. The page confirms the container version family and the deployed context path, and in some versions prints a stack trace.
remediation: Configure custom error pages at the application level so WebLogic does not render its own error page, and keep the container version out of responses.
limitation: Two body markers. A page that discusses WebLogic in documentation is not matched; the server error page must be rendered.

observation.body: WebLogic Server deployments should override the error page.
